title: gentianella chrysantha
intro: Gentianella chrysantha, commonly known as Golden Gentian, is a species of flowering plant in the gentian family (Gentianaceae). This plant is known for its bright yellow flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Gentianella chrysantha include its ability to aid in digestion and relieve symptoms of gastrointestinal disorders, such as nausea and bloating. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, gentiopicrivine, and amarogentin, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
